description: Assembly Majority Leader Cecilia Aguiar-Curry , State Senators Tom Umberg , Josh Becker , and Dr. Akilah Weber Pierson Join Former Assemblymembers Paul Fong and Warren Furutani and Senate Majority Leader Emeritus Bill Monning in Endorsing Dr. Pan Sacramento,
